result: The bug-hunter agent reviewed src/adservice (Java, gRPC). Structured findings are attached.

structured_output.summary: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE captured for the workshop's expected-output folder — your run will differ. The ad service is a small Java gRPC server; findings concentrate on error handling around feature-flag lookups and unbounded random ad selection.

findings.title: Feature-flag client failure propagates as INTERNAL for every getAds call
findings.description: Sample text: an exception from the flag provider is not caught around the evaluation call, so a flagd outage turns into failed ad requests instead of a default. Line number is a placeholder in this sample.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the flag evaluation in a try/catch that logs once and falls back to the default variant.

findings.title: Random ad selection can return duplicates and does not bound MAX_ADS_TO_SERVE against catalog size
findings.description: Sample text: the loop draws with replacement; with a small ad map the same ad may be served twice in one response. Line number is a placeholder in this sample.
findings.recommendation: Shuffle a copy of the list and take the first N distinct entries.
